title: The Amazon Program Almost Nobody Is Actually Doing (Full-Time)

speakers.name: Nick (Side Hustle Nation host, addressed as 'Nicky')

promo_conflict: Nate coaches people to do the Amazon Influencer Program (L1038) and strongly recommends specific paid tools (Chiching, multi-influencer pro) with no affiliate relationship disclosed. The host also takes part in the program.

stated_problem.quote: I want to see what some random mom named Rachel has to say about it.
stated_problem.speaker: Nate

idea.name: Amazon Influencer on-site review videos
idea.one_liner: Shoot lots of short, low-effort review videos of Amazon products (things you own, neighbours' homes, bin-store buys, free brand samples). Upload them to Amazon product pages and earn 1-2% Amazon commission plus 10-50% Creator Connections brand commission on the sales they influence.
idea.customer: Amazon shoppers already on a product listing (paid by Amazon and brands)
idea.offer: 1-3 minute authentic product review videos shown in the Amazon listing's video carousel
idea.revenue_model: Amazon influencer commission (1-2%) plus brand-funded Creator Connections commission (10-50%) on attributed sales

key_quotes.quote: You shoot these short product review videos, starting with the stuff you've already got lying around your house.
Or I could spend that same five minutes simply making a video for this mouse and uploading it and doing zero research.
And so that's become a huge part of our business is trying to find things that have creator connections on them.
Like, there's so much in your house that is a product on Amazon.

claims.claim: Guest earns $20,000 per month from the program
claims.quote: The fact that I can make $20,000 a month literally doing that is bonkers to me.

claims.claim: About 3,000 videos made in 10 months from a new account
claims.quote: I mean, 10 months ago from a new account to now 3,000 videos

claims.claim: Amazon pays 1-2% commission
claims.quote: If I sell a doorknob, I'll make one or two percent on that commission from Amazon.

claims.claim: Creator Connections brand campaigns pay 10-50% on top
claims.quote: the creator connection campaign will pay me anywhere from 10 to 50 percent.

claims.claim: Guest is happy with $1 per video per month (says his actual results are higher)
claims.quote: I am happy, my results are actually significantly higher than this, but I am happy if I make $1 per month per video.

claims.claim: About 10 minutes per video, so 6 videos per hour
claims.quote: Okay, well, that means I can make six of these per hour.

claims.claim: Typical beginner to mid-level creators earn $1.50-$2.50 per video per month
claims.quote: the average sort of beginner to mid level person is usually making about a buck 50 to $2 and a half dollars per video per month.

claims.claim: 2,000 automated brand sample requests get about a 10% response, around 200 free products
claims.quote: So if I send 2000 messages out, I'm gonna be getting about 200 things roughly seven days from now to my doorstep for free.

claims.claim: About 10% response rate on sample requests
claims.quote: I'm able to do that, and I will usually get about a 10% response rate.

claims.claim: Pays neighbours a $20 Starbucks gift card to film their items for an afternoon
claims.quote: I'll give you $20 of Starbucks money if you let me film at your house for an afternoon.

claims.claim: One farmers-market hand-washing station video earned over $100
claims.quote: And I made like I think I made over $100 in commissions from that hand washing thing

claims.claim: A long-form shed build video earned a couple of thousand dollars
claims.quote: I made a couple thousand dollars from that.

claims.claim: 30% of videos make 70% of profits
claims.quote: Maybe 30% of my videos are making me like 70% of my profits.

claims.claim: Guest projects $40-50k in a month in Q4
claims.quote: I am pretty confident that we can hit 40 to 50,000 in a month.

claims.claim: Guest knows others making $50-70k per month
claims.quote: I know people who are doing like 50 to 70 a month right now.

claims.claim: Guest estimates fewer than 1,000 full-time on-site influencers
claims.quote: I would estimate there's less than 1,000 people who are working full-time as on-site Amazon Influencers.

acquisition_channels.details: Videos are shown in the Amazon product-page video carousels with no outside marketing. Watch time and recency seem to affect placement.

Gets products to film via automated Creator Connections sample requests to brands, Facebook neighbourhood posts offering Starbucks gift cards, house-sitting, Airbnbs, model homes and Amazon bin stores

ideas.delivery: The founder physically handles and films each product, mostly on camera, with voiceover and no editing. They upload to Amazon and tag the ASIN. AI helps with talking points, titles and thumbnails.
ideas.other_uk_rules: ASA/CAP Code and CMA rules require clear disclosure of affiliate links and of free or gifted products. Filming inside other people's homes, or filming identifiable people, raises UK GDPR consent issues. Check the Amazon.co.uk influencer program terms and that Creator Connections is available in the UK.

idea.name: Amazon Associates for off-site influencers
idea.one_liner: Creators with their own off-site audience promote Amazon products with affiliate links and earn commission on sales.
idea.customer: An existing off-site audience (YouTube, social media)
idea.offer: Product recommendations with Amazon affiliate links

key_quotes.quote: there's also the Amazon affiliate program which is more for like off-site people.
you would be better suited to the affiliate program because you have an actual off-site following.

acquisition_channels.details: Relies on the creator's own off-site following

ideas.delivery: The creator publishes content on their own channels with affiliate links
ideas.other_uk_rules: ASA/CAP rules require affiliate links to be disclosed

stated_problem.quote: where we've had people toiling away, creating daily content for months and months and still not getting approved.
stated_problem.speaker: Nick (host)

idea.name: Facebook content monetization
idea.one_liner: Post high volumes of content on Facebook and earn platform payouts once accepted into the monetization program.

key_quotes.quote: And it's like, it's social media. So once it's done, it's done.

claims.claim: Requires posting about 10 times a day
claims.quote: like you got to post 10 times a day every day.

ideas.delivery: Creator posts content daily; each post has a short shelf life

idea.name: Amazon seller business
idea.one_liner: Sell physical products on Amazon as a third-party seller.

key_quotes.quote: back when I was on seller and doing that prominently, and I had friends doing the influencer program

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK product safety rules (GPSR/UKCA) and VAT registration thresholds

stated_problem.quote: if Amazon, let's say shuts me down, I would like to have a YouTube go
stated_problem.speaker: Nate

idea.name: Auto cross-post reviews to YouTube
idea.one_liner: Automatically re-upload Amazon review videos to YouTube with off-site affiliate links to earn ad revenue, brand deals and affiliate commission.
idea.revenue_model: YouTube ads, brand deals, off-site Amazon affiliate commission

key_quotes.quote: And it's downloading my videos from Amazon, adding descriptions, adding titles, changing thumbnails, all that stuff, adding my off-site affiliate links, and then uploading them on my behalf to YouTube all hands off.

claims.claim: Cross-posts 10-20 videos per day automatically
claims.quote: So I let this run and it usually runs like 10 to 20 videos per day

claims.claim: YouTube cross-posting adds 5-10% to monthly income
claims.quote: So for me, I'll see about a five to 10% income boost per month from off-site posting to like YouTube.

ideas.delivery: A tool (Chiching) downloads the Amazon videos, adds metadata and affiliate links, and uploads them to YouTube with no manual work
ideas.other_uk_rules: ASA/CAP rules on disclosing affiliate links and ads

stated_problem.quote: man, even if I don't make money from this, I can make money flip in this on Facebook marketplace.
stated_problem.speaker: Nate

idea.name: Resell free samples and bin-store finds
idea.one_liner: Resell free brand samples and heavily discounted bin-store items on Facebook Marketplace, eBay or Whatnot live streams for profit.
idea.revenue_model: Resale margin on items acquired free or cheap

key_quotes.quote: Just reselling free samples that they request from brands.
You just have to have the time to list all this stuff on marketplace and eBay and things like that, to actually do it.

claims.claim: Anyone could make $40-50k a year reselling free samples
claims.quote: We're talking like $40, $50,000, like a teacher salary, $40, $50,000 a year.

claims.claim: Air conditioners resell at about 95% of MSRP on Facebook Marketplace
claims.quote: you can still resell an air conditioner for like 95% MSRP if you're on Facebook marketplace.

acquisition_channels.details: Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Whatnot live stream

ideas.delivery: The founder lists, stores and hands over or ships physical items
ideas.other_uk_rules: HMRC digital platform reporting (platforms report sellers with 30+ sales or about £1,700 a year), and income tax/trading allowance. Consumer Rights Act and product safety duties apply if trading. Some brand sample agreements may forbid resale.

stated_problem.quote: Yeah, and this is, I would say the biggest roadblock that people get is the analysis paralysis manager.
stated_problem.speaker: Nate

idea.name: Amazon Influencer coaching
idea.one_liner: Coach beginners to get approved for the Amazon Influencer Program and produce videos at volume.

key_quotes.quote: I've been doing some coaching with people down just helping to teach other people how to do this.

acquisition_channels.details: Not stated; implied via reputation and podcast appearances

ideas.other_uk_rules: DMCC Act subscription-contract rules if coaching is billed on a recurring basis. Earnings claims must not mislead (CPRs/DMCC unfair commercial practices).

stated_problem.quote: I can't film every doorknob and every piece of hardware and whatever.
stated_problem.speaker: Nate

idea.name: Amazon influencer research/outreach SaaS
idea.one_liner: Software for Amazon influencers that scans products by image, shows influencer counts and Creator Connections campaigns, and automates sample-request messages to brands.
idea.offer: Product scanning, competition data and automated brand messaging

key_quotes.quote: It's called multi-influencer pro, which is then able to picture scan stuff and tell me, do these things have creator connections campaigns?
There are other popular tools or things like viral review, things like oink, things like flutes or fruit.

acquisition_channels.details: Not stated; recommended by creators like the guest

ideas.delivery: Software with an app, run by the vendor
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR for user data. DMCC Act subscription rules if sold to UK consumers. Amazon ToS risk for scraping and automated messaging.

idea.name: Amazon-to-YouTube cross-posting SaaS
idea.one_liner: Tool that pulls an influencer's Amazon videos and auto-uploads them to YouTube with titles, descriptions, thumbnails and affiliate links.

key_quotes.quote: It's called Chiching, which is so much better than anything else on the market.
for cross-posting, nothing is anywhere close to what this does because it just works in the background.

acquisition_channels.details: Creator recommendations such as this podcast

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR. DMCC Act subscription rules for UK consumers.

idea.name: Amazon returns bin store
idea.one_liner: Buy Amazon return pallets for pennies on the dollar and sell the items in a physical store at flat prices that drop through the week.

key_quotes.quote: And this is where people will buy, like, return palettes from Amazon for pennies on the dollar.

claims.claim: Prices drop through the week, e.g. $12 on Tuesday, $10 on Wednesday, $6 on Thursday
claims.quote: So Tuesday, everything is $12. And then Wednesday, everything is $10.

claims.claim: Items cost about $2 instead of $20
claims.quote: But you're paying $2 instead of $20 for it.

acquisition_channels.details: Physical store found via Google Maps

ideas.delivery: Physical retail store with staff handling pallets
ideas.other_uk_rules: Consumer Rights Act, GPSR product safety for returned goods, business rates and premises licensing
